title: 五类控制减风险（国内版）

points.K4: 回顾：评估到减缓的流程
points.S1: 条件不够不硬上，依法移交
points.S2: 控制好不好，绩效来验证
points.S3: 有了工程控制，操作仍要规范
points.S4: 控制要维护，定期检查验证

shots.scene: 欣欣站在一座五层彩色金字塔旁
shots.prompt_en: The panda mascot stands beside a five-band coloured pyramid.
shots.narration: 这一课，讲怎么用控制减风险。

shots.scene: 三个圆圈循环里，第二个圆被点亮
shots.prompt_en: Three circles form a loop; the second one lights up. No people.
shots.narration: 评估之后,就该动手减缓了。

shots.scene: 阿杰拿着评估报告，问“风险这么高怎么办”
shots.prompt_en: The young male student holds an assessment report with a worried look.
shots.narration: 阿杰评估完,风险有点高。

shots.scene: 阿杰想直接戴上口罩就开工，小研摆手
shots.prompt_en: The young male student grabs a mask to start; the female graduate student waves to stop.
shots.narration: 他想戴个口罩就干,小研拦住。

shots.scene: 小研指着五层金字塔
shots.prompt_en: The female graduate student points at a five-band pyramid.
shots.narration: 小研说:光靠防护不够,看这五类控制。

shots.scene: 欣欣举着一张写着“控制”的卡片
shots.prompt_en: The panda mascot holds up a card with a shield icon.
shots.narration: 控制,就是把风险降下来的办法。

shots.scene: 三个图标：概念、层级、各类简介
shots.prompt_en: Three icons: a concept bulb, a pyramid and an overview list. No people.
shots.narration: 三个目标:懂概念、

shots.scene: 层级和各类简介图标依次点亮
shots.prompt_en: The pyramid and overview icons light up in turn. No people.
shots.narration: 知道五类控制和层级,会认出并用。

shots.scene: 一个决策图标连到一串行动图标
shots.prompt_en: A decision icon links to a row of action icons. No people.
shots.narration: 控制,是落实管理决策的行动。

shots.section_title: 回顾：评估到减缓的流程
shots.scene: 四个方块自上而下：危害识别、评估、减缓、残余风险
shots.prompt_en: Four stacked blocks: hazard identification, assessment, mitigation, residual risk. No people.
shots.narration: 先回顾流程:识别危害、做评估、
overlay: 回顾：评估到减缓的流程

shots.section_title: 回顾：评估到减缓的流程
shots.scene: 箭头指向“减缓”方块，控制图标登场
shots.prompt_en: An arrow points to the mitigation block; control icons appear. No people.
shots.narration: 再减缓,控制就在这一步登场。

shots.scene: 一个菱形分叉，一边红一边绿
shots.prompt_en: A diamond decision node branching to a red side and a green side. No people.
shots.narration: 减缓后剩下的,叫残余风险。

shots.scene: 红色一边打叉：不可接受就不做
shots.prompt_en: The red branch gets a cross: not acceptable, do not proceed. No people.
shots.narration: 不可接受,就不做。

shots.scene: 绿色一边打勾：可接受才继续
shots.prompt_en: The green branch gets a check: acceptable, may proceed. No people.
shots.narration: 可接受,才谨慎继续。

shots.scene: 五层金字塔自上而下点亮
shots.prompt_en: A five-band pyramid lighting up from top to bottom. No people.
shots.narration: 控制分五类,从上往下选:

shots.scene: 金字塔最底层发亮，标“最后防线”
shots.prompt_en: The bottom band of the pyramid glows, marked as the last line. No people.
shots.narration: 个人防护是最后一道防线,放最底。

shots.scene: 欣欣举起一个大大的停止标志
shots.prompt_en: The panda mascot holds up a large stop sign.
shots.narration: 第一类:消除。

shots.scene: 一间空实验室,没有气流、没有柜子,都打叉
shots.prompt_en: An empty lab with no airflow and no cabinet, each marked with a cross. No people.
shots.narration: 没有气流、没有柜子、培训也不够,

shots.scene: 一张高风险样本被整体打叉,不开展
shots.prompt_en: A high-risk sample box crossed out entirely. No people.
shots.narration: 这种高风险操作,干脆不做。

shots.scene: 一支样本被标上“已灭活”,危害图标变灰
shots.prompt_en: A sample tube labelled as inactivated; its hazard icon turns grey. No people.
shots.narration: 第二类:替代。

shots.scene: 同样的任务,换成已灭活样本,风险条变短
shots.prompt_en: The same task with an inactivated sample; the risk bar shrinks. No people.
shots.narration: 样本来之前先灭活,风险就低了。

shots.scene: 小研在有生物安全柜的实验室里谨慎操作
shots.prompt_en: The female graduate student works carefully in a lab with a biosafety cabinet.
shots.narration: 有柜子、人也熟练,可谨慎进行。

shots.scene: 一个空盒子代表普通房间
shots.prompt_en: An empty box representing a bare room. No people.
shots.narration: 第三类:工程控制。

shots.scene: 盒子上方加过滤层,下方加污水处理层
shots.prompt_en: A filtration layer is added above the box and an effluent layer below. No people.
shots.narration: 加上高效过滤和污水处理,

shots.scene: 盒子里放进一台生物安全柜,接上排风管
shots.prompt_en: A biosafety cabinet is placed inside, connected to an exhaust duct. No people.
shots.narration: 放进生物安全柜,接好排风。

shots.scene: 气流箭头流进房间,屋内保持负压
shots.prompt_en: Airflow arrows flow into the room; it stays at negative pressure. No people.
shots.narration: 空气往里流、负压,就形成了封闭。

shots.scene: 八个小图标排成一列
shots.prompt_en: Eight small icons arranged in a column. No people.
shots.narration: 工程设计有八个部分:

shots.scene: 图标：设施设计、定向气流、过滤、暖通
shots.prompt_en: Icons: facility design, directional airflow, filters, HVAC. No people.
shots.narration: 设施设计、气流、过滤、暖通,

shots.scene: 图标：污水处理、给排水、智能控制、安防
shots.prompt_en: Icons: effluent treatment, plumbing, smart controls, security. No people.
shots.narration: 污水、给排水、智能控制和安防。

shots.scene: 一摞空白文件和一本空白手册
shots.prompt_en: A stack of blank documents and a blank manual. No people.
shots.narration: 第四类:管理控制。

shots.scene: 图标：政策、职责、规程、应急预案
shots.prompt_en: Icons: policy, roles, SOP, contingency plan. No people.
shots.narration: 政策、职责、规程、应急预案,

shots.scene: 图标：疫苗、培训、审核
shots.prompt_en: Icons: a vaccine, a training session, an audit checklist. No people.
shots.narration: 再加疫苗、培训和审核。

shots.scene: 欣欣指着一排防护用品图标
shots.prompt_en: The panda mascot points at a row of PPE icons.
shots.narration: 第五类:个人防护,最后一道防线。

shots.scene: 图标：手套、口罩、呼吸器
shots.prompt_en: Icons: gloves, a mask, a powered respirator. No people.
shots.narration: 手套、口罩、送风呼吸器,

shots.scene: 图标：防护服、护目镜;一副防咬抓手套
shots.prompt_en: Icons: a protective gown, goggles, and a bite-resistant glove. No people.
shots.narration: 防护服、护目镜;接触动物用防咬手套。

shots.scene: 工程、管理、防护三个圆圈相互重叠
shots.prompt_en: Three overlapping circles: engineering, administrative and PPE. No people.
shots.narration: 这些控制,要一起用。

shots.scene: 一副防护用品旁边配一张穿脱规程
shots.prompt_en: A set of PPE paired with a donning-and-doffing SOP sheet. No people.
shots.narration: 防护要配穿脱规程,规程是管理控制。

shots.scene: 实验室门口,一张进出规程贴在墙上
shots.prompt_en: A lab door with an entry-exit SOP posted beside it. No people.
shots.narration: 实验室是工程控制,进出靠规程管。

shots.section_title: 条件不够不硬上，依法移交
shots.scene: 阿杰面对条件不足的实验室,停下
shots.prompt_en: The young male student stops in front of an under-equipped lab.
shots.narration: 条件不够,别硬上。
overlay: 条件不够不硬上，依法移交

shots.section_title: 条件不够不硬上，依法移交
shots.scene: 一组方向相反的台阶,第一类在最高处红色警示
shots.prompt_en: Two opposite step sets; the top step marked with a red warning. No people.
shots.narration: 我国第一、二类最危险,须批准才做。

shots.section_title: 条件不够不硬上，依法移交
shots.scene: 高风险样本装进专用箱,移交有资质机构
shots.prompt_en: A high-risk sample is packed into a dedicated box and handed to a qualified institution. No people.
shots.narration: 按规定移交有资质的机构处理。

shots.section_title: 控制好不好，绩效来验证
shots.scene: 一串控制措施后面连着一个放大镜
shots.prompt_en: A row of control measures followed by a magnifying glass. No people.
shots.narration: 控制加了,就一定有效吗?
overlay: 控制好不好，绩效来验证

shots.section_title: 控制好不好，绩效来验证
shots.scene: 减缓后再做一次评估,风险条明显变短
shots.prompt_en: A re-assessment after mitigation; the risk bar is clearly shorter. No people.
shots.narration: 要靠绩效:减缓后再评估一次。

shots.section_title: 控制好不好，绩效来验证
shots.scene: 对勾表示风险真的降下来了
shots.prompt_en: A check mark confirms the risk has truly dropped. No people.
shots.narration: 确认真的降了,这一步才算数。

shots.section_title: 有了工程控制，操作仍要规范
shots.scene: 负压实验室里,阿杰却单手甩开盖子,被打叉
shots.prompt_en: In a negative-pressure lab, a careless one-handed action is crossed out. No people.
shots.narration: 有了好设施,操作就能随便吗?
overlay: 有了工程控制，操作仍要规范

shots.section_title: 有了工程控制，操作仍要规范
shots.scene: 工程控制图标旁边,操作规程图标一起亮起
shots.prompt_en: An engineering-control icon lights up together with an SOP icon. No people.
shots.narration: 工程控制不能代替规范操作。

shots.section_title: 有了工程控制，操作仍要规范
shots.scene: 小研按规程稳稳操作,气流顺畅
shots.prompt_en: The female graduate student works steadily by the SOP; airflow stays smooth.
shots.narration: 设施加规范,才真正安全。

shots.section_title: 控制要维护，定期检查验证
shots.scene: 日历上一个定期检查的标记
shots.prompt_en: A calendar with a periodic-check mark. No people.
shots.narration: 控制装好,还要常维护。
overlay: 控制要维护，定期检查验证

shots.section_title: 控制要维护，定期检查验证
shots.scene: 老李检测生物安全柜和过滤系统,贴合格标
shots.prompt_en: The facility engineer tests the cabinet and filter system and attaches a pass tag.
shots.narration: 柜子、过滤、负压,定期检测验证。

shots.section_title: 控制要维护，定期检查验证
shots.scene: 一张空白维护记录被填好归档
shots.prompt_en: A blank maintenance record is filled in and filed. No people.
shots.narration: 维护要留记录,坏了及时修。

shots.scene: 欣欣站在五层金字塔前
shots.prompt_en: The panda mascot stands in front of the five-band pyramid.
shots.narration: 小结:五类控制,按层级选。

shots.scene: 残余风险菱形和重叠的控制圆圈一起亮起
shots.prompt_en: The residual-risk diamond and the overlapping control circles light up. No people.
shots.narration: 看残余风险决定做不做,控制要并用。

shots.scene: 国内台阶、移交箱、绩效放大镜、维护记录图标
shots.prompt_en: Icons of domestic steps, a transfer box, a performance magnifier and a maintenance log. No people.
shots.narration: 条件不够就移交,控制要验证和维护。

shots.scene: 欣欣和小研、阿杰、老周、老李一起挥手
shots.prompt_en: The panda mascot waves goodbye with the female graduate student, the young male student, the older man and the facility engineer.
shots.narration: 控制用对用全,风险才稳,再见!
